title: Security Operations & Threat Detection — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Automated Cryptomining Malware Containment: from suspicious outbound Stratum protocol connection detection to VM snapshot and forensic network isolation.
routing_rationale: Automated forensic response preserves volatile memory and disk state for security analysts before severing network connectivity, ensuring evidence is preserved for prosecution.

nodes.label: Cryptomining Process
nodes.detail: Malware spawned via unpatched web vulnerability; connects to mining pool.

nodes.label: Mining Pool Outbound Connection
nodes.detail: Sends proof-of-work hashes to malicious mining pool IP.

nodes.label: SCC Finding: CRYPTOMINING
nodes.detail: Identifies known mining pool IP address from Google Threat Intelligence database.

nodes.label: Forensic Disk Snapshot
nodes.detail: Creates point-in-time forensic image of infected disk for evidence analysis.

nodes.label: Apply Quarantine Tag
nodes.detail: Applies network tag 'quarantine'; drops 100% of ingress and egress traffic.

steps.title: Threat Identification
steps.action: VPC flow log records connection to mining pool; SCC Event Threat Detection triggers finding.
steps.why_traversal: Detects cryptomining within seconds without needing agent software inside the VM.

steps.title: Forensic Capture & Isolation
steps.action: Automated pipeline snapshots disk for digital forensics and drops all traffic.
steps.why_traversal: Preserves forensic evidence while eliminating compute cost and risk of lateral spread.

scenarios.label: Disk Snapshot Timeout During High I/O
scenarios.root_cause: Disk saturated by mining malware I/O; snapshot request queued for 120 seconds.
scenarios.diverted_path: Isolation delayed while waiting for snapshot.
scenarios.blast_radius: Additional 2 minutes of unauthorized network egress.
scenarios.recovery: Execute network quarantine tag application concurrently before initiating disk snapshot.
